title: Introducing Fluorescently Labeled CRISPR/Cas9 RNP Complex into Dinoflagellates
author: Brittany N Sprecher
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bei2jcge

steps.title: Prepare gRNA Complex
steps.instruction: Combine 1 uL Alt-R™ CRISPR/Cas9 tracrRNA – ATTO™ 550 (100 uM), 1 uL Alt-R™ CRISPR/Cas9 crRNA (100 uM), and 18 uL IDT Nuclease Free Buffer.

substeps.instruction: Incubate the mixture at 95˚C for 5 minutes.
Allow the mixture to cool to room temperature on the bench.

steps.title: Prepare Cas9 Enzyme Solution
steps.instruction: Combine 2.67 uL Alt-R Cas9 Enzyme (61 uM) with 37.33 uL IDT Nuclease Free Buffer.

steps.title: Form RNP Complex
steps.instruction: Combine 1-part gRNA (from step 1) and 1-part Cas9 (from step 2) to form the RNP complex.

substeps.instruction: Incubate at room temperature for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Prepare Oxyrrhis marina Cells
steps.instruction: Concentrate healthy O. marina cells using a flashlight, ensuring no background fluorescence under green light.

substeps.instruction: Count cell concentration using a Sedgewick Rafter Counting Chamber (target: 200,000 cells/well for electroporation).

steps.title: Harvest and Wash Cells
steps.instruction: Spin down the necessary O. marina cells (including NPC and scrambled gRNA controls) at 2500g for 2.5 mins.

substeps.instruction: Remove all but 2-5 mL of liquid without disturbing the pellet and transfer gently to 2 mL test tubes.
Centrifuge at 900g for 1 minute and remove all remaining liquid.

steps.title: Resuspend Cells in Buffer
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in electroporation buffer.

steps.title: Prepare Electroporation Mixture
steps.instruction: For each experimental well, combine 16.4 uL Lonza’s SG Buffer, 3.6 uL Lonza’s Supplement 1 Solution, and 2 uL RNP complex.

steps.title: Perform Electroporation
steps.instruction: Gently place 22 uL of the mixture into each well of Lonza’s Nucleocuvette™ 16-well strips and electroporate using the desired setting.

steps.title: Post-Electroporation Recovery
steps.instruction: Immediately add 80 uL of filtered and autoclaved seawater containing an antibiotic cocktail to limit bacterial growth.

substeps.instruction: After 20-30 minutes, transfer each well to a 24-well culture plate containing 1.4 mL of the same filtered/autoclaved seawater.

steps.title: Monitor Fluorescence and Analyze
steps.instruction: Observe cells for red fluorescence under green light to demonstrate RNP complex uptake.

substeps.instruction: Continue observing fluorescence for 3 days (RNP complexes typically degrade after 72 hours).
Isolate gDNA after ~72 hours and perform T7E1 endonuclease assay to determine gene editing efficiency.
